==English==
{{was wotd|2007|November|24}}

===Etymology===
From {{bor|en|la|refūtō|t=refute, repudiate}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{enPR|rĭ-fyo͞ot|rə-fyo͞ot}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈfjuːt/|/ɹəˈfjuːt/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈfjut/|/ɹəˈfjut/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-refute.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈfjʉːt/|a=AU}}
** {{audio|en|en-au-refute.ogg|a=Queensland}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹəˈfjʉːt/|a=NZ}}
* {{hyphenation|en|re|fute}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːt|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[prove]] (something) to be [[false]] or [[incorrect]].
#: {{syn|en|debunk|disprove|rebut|confound}}
#: {{ant|en|confirm|affirm|demonstrate|prove}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|proscribed}} To [[deny]] the [[truth]] or [[correctness]] of (something); to reject or disagree with an accusation.
#: {{syn|en|dispute|deny|repudiate|rebut|gainsay|counterargue|reject}}
#: {{ant|en|affirm|accept|embrace|profess}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Taro Kaneko|title=Family ‘banned from more than 1,000 petrol stations’ amid fuel theft row|passage=A spokesperson for VARS Technology said: “We completely refute the suggestion that our market-leading ANPR system is unreliable".|date=20 December 2025|url=https://www.theguardian.com/money/2025/dec/20/fuel-theft-row-banned-petrol-stations-cash}}

====Usage notes====
* The second meaning of {{m|en|refute||to deny the truth of}} is [[proscribed]] as [[erroneous]] by some [http://books.google.co.uk/books?id=2yJusP0vrdgC&pg=PA807&lpg=PA807&dq=english+usage+refute&source=web&ots=nYrYodyZZ4&sig=G_alFFyWi7ZFBMYnaujrrrh9qUM&hl=en&sa=X&oi=book_result&resnum=4&ct=result| (compare Merriam Webster,1994)]. An alternative term with such a meaning is {{m|en|repudiate}}, which means to reject or refuse to acknowledge, but without the implication of justification.
* ''Refute'' is also often confused with ''[[rebut]]''; a ''[[rebuttal]]'', in formal debate terms, is a counter-refutation, and it also has a specific legal sense, though like ''[[refutation]]'', the word has taken on the informal and disputed meaning of ''[[denial]]''.
